title: UL-06 — Challenge: NAT gateway then delete
scenario: Same NAT pattern as GL-06 but you choose CIDRs and document hourly + data processing cost before create.
acceptanceCriteria: VPC with public and private subnets created with LabId=ul-06 tags.
Elastic IP allocated in vpc domain and associated only with NAT.
NAT gateway placed in public subnet and reaches available state.
Private route table sends 0.0.0.0/0 to the NAT gateway.
Cost-risk phrase `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` recorded before NAT create.
Hourly and per-GB NAT pricing noted from official pages.
describe-nat-gateways shows your NAT before teardown.
NAT gateway deleted and wait until deleted state.
Elastic IP released after NAT delete.
No NAT gateways remain in the VPC.
Subnets and VPC deleted after NAT cleanup.
No running ENIs left in lab VPC.
Same session teardown verified with describe calls.

hints.text: NAT partial hours bill full hour.

solution.outline: NAT lab with cost gate and cleanup.

stopChargesPanel: Delete NAT, EIP, VPC for ul-06.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: if ($NatGatewayId) { aws ec2 delete-nat-gateway --nat-gateway-id $NatGatewayId; aws ec2 wait nat-gateway-deleted --nat-gateway-ids $NatGatewayId }
if ($NatGatewayId) { aws ec2 delete-nat-gateway --nat-gateway-id $NatGatewayId; aws ec2 wait nat-gateway-deleted --nat-gateway-ids $NatGatewayId }
if ($AlbArn) { aws elbv2 delete-load-balancer --load-balancer-arn $AlbArn; aws elbv2 wait load-balancers-deleted --load-balancer-arns $AlbArn }

if ($AsgName) { aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --min-size 0 --max-size 0 --desired-capacity 0; aws autoscaling delete-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --force-delete }
if ($InstanceId) { aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids $InstanceId; aws ec2 wait instance-terminated --instance-ids $InstanceId }
if ($IgwId -and $VpcId) { aws ec2 detach-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId --vpc-id $VpcId; aws ec2 delete-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-06 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-06 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-06 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-06. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-06) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
